column7: full/expected personal prefix: 1=nu-, 2=ku-, X=mu- (consonant-initial general: expected prefix used regardless of dependency)
full third-person prefix (base set); retained unless a conditioning class applies
prefix loses its vowel (nu->n-, ku->k-): dependent vowel-initial noun/verb stem
full prefix + intrusive -t- before a vowel-initial stem that is not dependent (nouns; AI verbs pp.31,33)
third-person wu- drops its w before m, p, k, or w-initial stems
prefixes lose their vowel before /8/-initial stems (the /8/ is vowel-initial)
third-person wu- deleted entirely before /8/-initial stems (also -8kas 'mother')
full third-person prefix wu- retained as wuh- before Mass /hC/ clusters (/hp/, /hk/, /hq/); attested variant spelling uh- (u-)
NI third-person: no possessive theme marker
NA third-person animate possessor theme -ah; in third-person plural the theme surfaces -uw + -ah with the intervening -ôw- (wuneechanuwôwah, 8shuwôwah, wutahtuquwôwah, umuseesuwôwah)
possession theme -m class (dependent nouns never take -m; not all nouns take it)
AI third-person singular and plural take no prefix (third person marked by suffix)
TI/TA objective third-person keeps the wu- prefix (drops its w before p-initial stems)
plural-object markers: -ash (NI) / -ak (NA); the third-person plural object carries the intervening -ôw- before the marker (nuhkôtash, wuhkontash, n8shak)
